liveReview.injectionPrefixBatch:
The following is feedback from another AI reviewer on this batch of changes. The reviewer saw only the diff and current file, not the full context, and may misjudge or over-review.

Handle it via this flow, not blanket acceptance:
1. Assess each suggestion:
   - Valid: briefly state what you will fix
   - Partially valid: which point you adopt, why the rest does not apply
   - Invalid: give a rebuttal (intended behavior / context already handled / reviewer misread)
2. Report verdicts as a short list.
3. Only modify code for valid items. Do not churn just to look busy.

Scope: {{count}} file(s) ({{files}})

preferences.title: Chat Preferences
preferences.cavemanModeHint: Append a compression rule to the system prompt so the model drops articles, filler, and pleasantries — keeping all technical content. Targets ~65% output token reduction at the standard level. Works on Claude and Codex.

cavemanLevelHint.off: Disabled. The model writes in its normal verbose style.
cavemanLevelHint.lite: Drop only filler and hedging (just / really / actually …). Keep articles and complete sentences. Best when the audience expects polished prose.
cavemanLevelHint.full: Classic compression: drop articles, fragments OK, short synonyms. ~65% output token reduction. Best general-purpose default.
cavemanLevelHint.ultra: Extreme compression: abbreviate prose words (DB / auth / config), strip conjunctions, use arrows for causality (X → Y). Code symbols and API names stay verbatim.
cavemanLevelHint.wenyan: Classical Chinese 文言文 (output uses Simplified Chinese characters). 80–90% character reduction. Code, identifiers, file paths, URLs and error strings are kept in their original Latin/ASCII form.

prompts.portfolio: Build me a modern personal portfolio website with a hero section, project showcase gallery, about me section, and a contact form. Use a dark theme with smooth scroll animations. Must use responsive layout that works perfectly on mobile, tablet and desktop. On mobile use single-column layout with touch-friendly interactions
prompts.ecommerce: Build me an e-commerce product page with an image carousel, pricing and specs info, user reviews section, and add-to-cart functionality. Clean and modern design style. Must use responsive layout that works perfectly on mobile, tablet and desktop. On mobile show full-width images and optimize touch interactions
prompts.dashboard: Build me a data analytics dashboard with stat cards at the top, line and bar chart areas, a data table, and sidebar filters. Use a dark tech-inspired style. Must use responsive layout that works perfectly on mobile, tablet and desktop. On mobile collapse sidebar into bottom drawer, stack cards in single column, and make tables horizontally scrollable
prompts.blog: Build me a tech blog homepage with a featured article hero area, article list cards, category tag filters, and a sidebar with popular posts. Clean and readable typography. Must use responsive layout that works perfectly on mobile, tablet and desktop. On mobile collapse sidebar to bottom and optimize reading experience
prompts.landing: Build me a SaaS product landing page with a hero section, core features overview, pricing comparison table, testimonials, and a CTA signup area. Professional and persuasive design. Must use responsive layout that works perfectly on mobile, tablet and desktop. On mobile use card carousel for pricing and optimize CTA button tap areas
prompts.restaurant: Build me a restaurant booking website with venue showcase, menu browsing by category, an online reservation form, and business info. Warm and elegant style. Must use responsive layout that works perfectly on mobile, tablet and desktop. On mobile use accordion menus and optimize form input experience
prompts.weather: Build me a weather forecast app with a current weather card, 7-day forecast list, temperature line chart, and city search. Use gradient backgrounds that change with weather conditions. Must use responsive layout that works perfectly on mobile, tablet and desktop. On mobile use stacked card layout and optimize touch gestures
prompts.todoApp: Build me a task management app with a task list, add/edit/delete functionality, priority labels, completion status toggle, and filtering/sorting. Clean and efficient interface. Must use responsive layout that works perfectly on mobile, tablet and desktop. On mobile use swipe actions instead of buttons and optimize keyboard input experience
prompts.socialFeed: Build me a social media feed page with post cards (avatar, text, images), like and comment interactions, a new post composer, and a profile sidebar. Must use responsive layout that works perfectly on mobile, tablet and desktop. On mobile hide sidebar, use adaptive-width images and optimize touch interactions
prompts.musicPlayer: Build me an online music player UI with a song list, album cover display, playback controls (progress bar, play/pause, prev/next), and a lyrics display area. Trendy design style. Must use responsive layout that works perfectly on mobile, tablet and desktop. On mobile fix playback bar to bottom and optimize touch control areas
